plan.goal: Resolve the billing discrepancy for Sara from Acme regarding the August invoice.
assumptions: The contract attached specifies the agreed monthly billing amount.
The customer claims the invoice amount is double the expected $1,200.
The invoice for August is available in the billing system.
The customer expects a correction or explanation for the discrepancy.

args.query: contract terms for sara@acme.com monthly billing amount

args.subject: Regarding your August invoice billing discrepancy
args.body:
Dear Sara,

We are currently reviewing your August invoice and the contract terms you provided. We will get back to you shortly with an explanation or correction.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Support Team

stopping_conditions: Invoice amount matches contract terms and no discrepancy is found.
Invoice amount is incorrect and a correction has been issued or escalated.
Customer has been informed of the status or resolution.
